module: COLLADA exporter (.dae 1.4.1) for the 'baked' kit pieces of the editor tools. Serializes meshParts ({ verts, normals, uvs, faces, material, tint? }) into documents that BeamNG's Torque loader reads as a static shape, to place them as TSStatic. Handles: simple shape, multi-material, and multi-LOD with collision mesh ('<gid>_p<i>_L<size>', 'Colmesh-1', 'nulldetail<size>' nodes under a base00/start01 hierarchy required by the importer). Shapes go either in the published root /assets/procedural_meshes/ or in the working root /assets/procedural_meshes_wip/ (filtered out of the build).
notes: Files are written via writeFile (VFS path); the functions return the result of writeFile.
prepDir EMPTIES the folder: it refuses (E log) any path that is not under procRoot or wipRoot, and also empties /temp<dir>. It acts only once per folder and per run (reset by beginBake).
(ox,oy,oz) is a local origin subtracted from all vertices: place the TSStatic at this origin; avoids exceeding the engine's 2048 m range.
If only one part has a tint, all parts are whitened (tint = {1,1,1}) to get consistent colors; writeDaeLODs and writeDaeParts both do this.
Two consecutive identical LODs are merged (kept at the smallest size).
In the RELEASED table (empty for now), outDir tests RELEASED[folder]: so RELEASED['kitName'] = true must be set; adding the name as a list element as the comment suggests would not work.
The date written in <created>/<modified> is fixed (2020-01-01).

procRoot.desc: Published root of the generated shapes: '/assets/procedural_meshes/'.

lenTag.desc: Converts a length into a label safe for file names/ids: 16.0 -> "16", 0.5 -> "0_5", 0.125 -> "0_125".

writeDae.desc: Serializes `part` and writes it to the VFS path `path` as a simple static shape (one node, material linked by name).

part.desc: meshPart { verts, normals, uvs, faces, tint? }

gid.desc: Geometry/node id (also the base name of the file)

writeDaeParts.desc: Writes a list of parts (each with .material) into a single multi-material .dae (one effect/material/geometry/node per part).

ox.desc: Local origin x subtracted from the vertices (default 0)

writeDaeLODs.desc: Writes a multi-LOD shape with collision. lods = { {size=S, parts={...}}, ... } by decreasing S (LOD0 = largest S); colParts = pieces of the collision mesh ('Colmesh-1' node); nullSize adds an empty node 'nulldetail<nullSize>' under which the shape disappears.

beginBake.desc: Starts a bake run: the next prepDir of each folder empties it again.

prepDir.desc: Prepares an output folder: empties it if it exists, otherwise creates it, and empties its equivalent under /temp. Only once per folder and per run. Refuses (error log) a folder outside procRoot/wipRoot; no effect if FS is absent.

dir.desc: VFS folder under procRoot or wipRoot

outDir.desc: Folder where a kit's baked shapes live: published root if RELEASED[folder] is true, otherwise working root. Takes the folder name alone.
